name: Nisha luthra

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Nisha Luthra is a poet, playwright and theatre director associated with Chandigarh. As founder and director of The Narrators Performing Arts Society, she works across staged stories, poetry and adaptations of books. Her Hindi collection Uns explores love and human relationships, while her theatre work includes writing and performing Drama Queen and directing literary adaptations for the stage.

In ‘Wandering in Time’, the speaker moves through memories, attachments and changing understandings of the self. Clocks and a suitcase give ordinary shapes to the passage of experience, while images of rain, sunsets and first encounters keep it fluid. The poem questions permanence and makes room for a life that unfolds at its own pace.
